slides.title: Nobody Negotiates Their First Cyber Offer
slides.subtitle: It's costing you more than you think

bullets: 70% of employers expect you to negotiate
Average cyber uplift is $8-15K when you ask
Research comp bands before interview day
Silence after their number is your best tool

caption: Your first offer is rarely their best offer - and most people just say yes. In cyber, where demand outstrips supply, you have more leverage than you think. Use it. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #salarychat #negotiation #cypherjobs
